byte_evidence.method: Parse attributable input_text JSON and count UTF-8 bytes of decoded exec_command.output only. Include listings/counts/source reads, exclude protocol wrappers, bootstrap/edit/test output and local tool metadata discovery. Captured inputs reviewed as data, never executed.

notes: All eight wrappers manually interpreted; final wrapper contains two nested test calls, so actual nested total is nine. ALL_TOOLS.filter is one local discovery operation with zero nested tool invocations. No aide operation occurs; tool names in scratch fixtures are data.

Guided treatment conforms via small-file/most-contents exception. Participant first measures 161/179/52/65/21-line files, then reads the full debug fixture spanning tracker, dedup, recovery, types and reproducer. No large partially relevant source file calls for mandatory outline-first handling here.

All shell commands start rtk and task workdirs/source edits are assigned-root scoped. Only allowed dedup.ts, tracker.ts and types.ts changed. Root-level pruning-regression.test.ts is allowed scratch; its temporary data uses import.meta.dir with afterAll cleanup. Mandatory reproducer temporary data is permitted test runtime. Provided reproducer immutable, provenance integrity passes.

No prohibited out-of-root source/evidence lookup, other-trial/reference/grader reads, global/index retrieval, memory, internet or delegation observed. Scope is source/edit/work-product boundaries, not complete syscall tracing.
Three test calls: expected pre-fix visible failure, successful post-fix visible and scratch tests. No transport errors or retries after a tool error.
Bytes are returned text, not tokens or causal savings. Quality checks are separate and grades unchanged.
